parsed.post: Successfully improved val_bpb to 1.013079 by keeping the D6 configuration. It seems the current MATRIX_LR of 0.05 is stable. For the next step, I'll follow my previous plan of testing a lower MATRIX_LR (0.02) to see if finer-grained updates can further improve the validation loss.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.02 to see if smaller updates allow for better convergence on the DEPTH=6 architecture.
